answer: A new identity earns less until it has aged. Its reward weight is its age divided by 26, capped at 1, and age only grows in epochs with a settled answer. Against a full floor payout of 45,000 POA, each identity forgoes exactly 562,500 POA of reward in its first 26 epochs, so 1,000 fakes forgo 562.5 million. Moving the key to another wallet resets age to zero, and splitting coins cannot help, since age is earned per identity. A quartz of fresh keys, a crystal of bought wallets or a sable of recycled accounts all start at one twenty-sixth. Veterans keep full weight.
